address: Stadsdeelkantoor Nieuw-West, Plein '40-'45 1, Amsterdam (1964 ten-storey slab with vertical fins on a glazed podium)
notes: Former stadsdeelkantoor at Plein '40-'45 (pand 0363100012076903, 1964, 107 LoD2.2 surfaces, roof max 43.7 m): a ten-storey slab (45 by 16 m) on a two-storey glazed podium. North front (surfaces 43/83 and 16/49/107, 2019-07-24 panorama w01-15, sharp): light concrete spandrel bands and continuous ribbon windows between eight tall dark vertical fins that project above the roof line, the three red St Andrew's crosses stacked on the roof corner at the top right, three smaller crosses on the podium beside the entrance, a glazed entrance hall with revolving door under the slab. West end (surface 5, 2022-06-30 w04-285): five bays of large dark ribbon windows between pale spandrel bands, the slab standing on two round piers over a glazed podium.

Signature: the red crosses MODELLED (kit component crosses: three medium crosses at the right end of the upper north wall; in the photograph they stand at the roof corner above the slab, so they sit about two storeys lower here); ribbon windows between spandrel bands MODELLED (ribbon-windows, 7 + aligned upper storeys on the north face, 10 on the west end); vertical fins SIMPLIFIED (piers: true gives shallow projecting piers at the bay joints, not the 3 m deep dark blades that rise over the roof); the three podium crosses by the entrance SKIPPED (too-small and the podium surfaces are not wall panels of 2 m or more in the 3DBAG volume); glazed entrance hall with revolving door SKIPPED (the podium walls are in no panel above the 4 m width threshold; the ground floor stays the surveyed shell); the two round piers under the slab SKIPPED (too-small: inside the 3DBAG volume).

The south wall (surfaces 90 and 67) and the east end (56) have no panorama (candidates 0); they carry an INFERRED ribbon-window grid so the audit blank-wall gate passes, matching the west end. Colours: pale grey concrete is the wall palette, dark glass frames.

Measured 2026-10-14 (measure.ts, evidence in measured.json): groups 2, 3 take the photo's wall and glass colour, window shape, bay count and front class; walls[2] glass #39484c not used (not darker than the wall #524c49 by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept; walls[3] glass #696665 not used (not darker than the wall #5e5e5d by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept.
